name: Waitr Holdings Inc.
summary: Waitr Holdings Inc. previously managed an online technology platform throughout the United States, which allowed users to order a wide array of goods including meals, alcoholic beverages, convenience store items, groceries, flowers, and even automotive parts. This platform also served to link various merchants, like restaurants, with external entities offering payment processing services. The company, established in Lafayette, Louisiana, in 2013,, along with its affiliates, initiated a voluntary Chapter 7 liquidation petition on April 2, 2024, at the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.
